### Category

C

### Project Title

Winodwsmenu 

### Project Description

WindowsMenu (by blackmatriXblack)

WindowsMenu is a lightweight, open-source Windows utility designed to customize and enhance the Windows right-click context menu (also known as the shell menu). It provides a simple way to add, edit, hide, or remove context-menu entries for files, folders, and desktop backgrounds without manual registry editing.

Key Features

• Context Menu Management: Enable/disable, add, delete, or rename right-click menu items for files, directories, and the desktop.

• Custom Commands: Add your own custom actions (e.g., open with a specific app, run scripts) to the context menu￼￼￼.

• User-Friendly UI: Clean, minimal interface built for easy navigation—no advanced technical skills required.

• System Compatibility: Works on Windows 10 and Windows 11 (32-bit/64-bit).

• Lightweight & Portable: Small footprint; no installation required (single executable).

• Safety: Disables items instead of deleting them (reversible changes) and supports backup/restore settings.

Use Cases

• Clean up cluttered right-click menus (remove unused entries from old software).

• Add quick actions (e.g., “Open in Terminal,” “Copy Path,” “Compress to ZIP”).

• Organize context menus for better productivity.

Tech Stack

• Language: C# (WPF for the UI).

• Framework: .NET (compatible with .NET 5/6/7/8/9)￼￼￼.

• License: MIT (free for personal and commercial use)￼￼￼.


### Highlights

New tool for windows
